title: Zelensky Links Russian Energy Attacks to Continuing Starshield Restrictions
detail: Zelensky said Russian attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure are made possible by continuing restrictions on Starshield. Only a headline summary was available; the specifics of the restrictions and any response are not confirmed.

title: Ukraine Reportedly Hits Kerch Bridge, Launches Largest Drone Attack on Russia Including Moscow
detail: Headline reports say Ukraine struck the Kerch (Crimean) bridge and launched its biggest drone attack on Russia since the war began, including a large assault on Moscow. Only aggregated headline summaries were available; damage, casualties and Russian official claims are not confirmed.

title: Le Monde: French Military Personnel Now Operating in Ukraine
detail: Le Monde reports that French military personnel are now operating in Ukraine. Only the headline summary was available; the number, role and location of personnel and any official French or Ukrainian confirmation are not established.
